date.as_written: abdenaṃdahutāśavāridhinisānāthā 1439 hvayākhyānvite śrīmadvikramabhūpateś ca vibhave māse navasye site pakṣe viṣṇudine gurau

notes: The chronogram and numerical date (VS 1439 Nabhasya śukla 11 Thursday) appears in verse 1 as the date of composition by King Vīrasiṃha ('śrīvīrasiṃho ʼbhyadhād granthaṃ'), though the cataloguer listed it as the date of copying. Scribe Viśvarūpa is mentioned in verse 2.
